selection: One exact anchored escaped test name per fresh process; every selected callback executes once. Nonmatching registrations are excluded by Node test-name-pattern; their reported skips do not represent mandatory tests.
discovery: Read-only source extraction of literal top-level test calls, plus the four finite loop expansions declared in these source-bound files. No import or test discovery execution.
topLevelReview: No helper, worker or test execution outside selected callbacks. Package suite creates only its scratch directory. No hooks, nested tests, skip/only declarations or cross-test state dependencies were found.
